verification.note: addons/intelligence/.github/workflows/ci.yml:148-152 sets node-version 20 with cache-dependency-path core/frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml, then runs pnpm install --frozen-lockfile in core/frontend (:163-165). Node 20 also appears at addons/knowledge ci.yml:147,243, addons/media_import ci.yml:176,272 and addons/cloud-sync ci.yml:127. frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml:3121-3124 pins isomorphic-dompurify@3.23.0 with engines ^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0 and the deprecation note. jsdom@30.1.3 (:3180-3182) has the same range and undici@8.13.1 (:4167-4169) requires >=22.19.0. MarkdownPreview.tsx:21 imports isomorphic-dompurify, and vitest.config.ts:67-70 aliases only '@'. Core ci.yml has node-version 24 at all seven sites. I did not run a Node 20 job to watch it fail.

docs/specs/ci-browser-container.md:45-51 still describes setting up Node 20 and running the tests on Node 20, and :226 says 'I9. The browser jobs run their tests on Node 20'. tests/test_ci_browser_jobs.py:118-123 is commented 'SPEC-CORE-149 I9, item 3: Node 24' and asserts node-version == "24".

This is the same defect as R1. .github/workflows/ci.yml:65-67 confirms that the four addon repos call `pnpm test` against core's develop tip. The addon workflows set Node 20 (see R1). frontend/pnpm-workspace.yaml has no engine-strict, so pnpm only warns at install and the incompatibility appears at runtime. The lockfile engine ranges match the claim.

tests/test_ci_browser_jobs.py:118-125 parametrizes only BROWSER_JOBS, and a grep of tests/ finds no other node-version or node:24 assertion. ci.yml has setup-node with node-version 24 at 46,128,187,271,328,375,423, and only the browser jobs are tested. frontend/Dockerfile:1,28,32 use FROM node:24-alpine, and no test references the frontend Dockerfile (tests/test_backend_dockerfile.py covers only backend/Dockerfile).

useFolderFiles.ts:184-191 calls setRunNow during render, and the comment says this is so no render commits a request built from the previous run's clock. useFolderFiles.modified.test.tsx:274-286 asserts listingModified()[0] for the first run, then after the rerender only waitFor(listingModified().at(-1) equal to the new cutoff). A stale-clock request made in between would still pass.

mcp-server/src/server.ts:79 passes tool.inputSchema (raw zod shape). toolMetadata.test.ts:118 calls listTools() but asserts only names, annotations and instructions (lines 125-159), with no inputSchema or properties check. The other listTools() uses (compactOutput.test.ts:166, readDocument.test.ts:179, searchTools.test.ts:244) check only the name. Other tests build z.object(inputSchema) locally and do not check the advertised JSON Schema. mcp-server/pnpm-lock.yaml:2569 resolves zod-to-json-schema@3.25.2(zod@4.6.7). decisions.md:111 says 'The mcp-server, which was skipped.'

unspecified_scores.reason: Saving a knowledge clip from pasted HTML that starts with a text line followed by a heading stores Markdown without the blank line, a small formatting change the user may notice in the source view.
Starting the knowledge addon container logs a harmless urllib3 PySocks DependencyWarning that only appears in logs.
Switching drives gives the sidebar section list a new identity and causes an extra recompute or re-render that the user cannot see.
When an MCP client sends a malformed or out-of-range argument, it sees zod 4's error wording instead of zod 3's, and the call is rejected either way.
Saving a pasted-HTML clip with a leading text line and then a heading loses the blank line before the heading in the stored Markdown.
Each start of the frontend container logs a DEP0060 util._extend deprecation warning from http-proxy, visible only in logs.
Importing the knowledge image prints a PySocks DependencyWarning in the logs, with no functional effect.

specification_compliance: SPEC-CORE-149 text (I9 and item 3) still says Node 20, while ci.yml and its test say Node 24, so the spec and the code disagree.
regression_risks: Addon CI jobs that run core develop's frontend on Node 20 may fail at runtime in jsdom 30 or undici 8 (engines >=22), because pnpm does not enforce engines here.
Changes to the advertised MCP tool JSON Schema under zod 4 would not be caught by any test.
test_coverage: Node 24 is pinned by a test only for the two browser jobs; the other five setup-node sites and frontend/Dockerfile are untested.
The per-run search clock test checks only the last listing request.
not_verified: Did not run any addon CI job on Node 20 to confirm that jsdom 30 or undici 8 actually fail at runtime there.
Did not count the core test files that render MarkdownPreview (claimed at least 8).
Did not run the knowledge clip conversion or containers to observe the unspecified behaviors.
Did not check whether the MCP SDK 1.32 advertised JSON Schema actually differs from before.
